name: Screen heading
summary: A product page header — a title/greeting or a breadcrumb trail on the left, action buttons on the right, responsive across desktop / tablet / phone.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-screen-heading> — the product page header. A TITLE AREA on the left is the page title, rendered by the reused <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> (the DS's single page-heading owner): a plain `title` is a single-crumb page title, a `breadcrumb` JSON array is the heading with its `›` ancestor path in front. The one exception is a brand-accent `highlight` greeting — "Welcome, **Brian**!" — a coloured name the breadcrumb can't express, so that stays a local <h1> matched to the breadcrumb page-title solo. An ACTIONS AREA on the right is a slot the consumer fills with <aha-button>s. An optional `description` subtitle sits under the title. `device` gives a deterministic responsive layout for the docs / qa: desktop + tablet keep title-left / actions-right on one row, phone wraps the actions below. REUSE, not rewrite — the title IS <aha-breadcrumb>, the actions are slotted <aha-button>s; this element only lays the two areas out. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) renders it directly via attributes (breadcrumb is a JSON attribute); Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design; the page title and the action buttons are the DS's own <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> / <aha-button> primitives, never rewritten here — the sole local <h1> is the accent greeting.

spec.label: Type
spec.value: title = <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> — Heading4 24 / SemiBold 600 / line-height 1.3 / #1A1A1A (text-default) for a single-crumb page title; 18/600 with an ancestor path

spec.label: Highlight
spec.value: optional `highlight` substring of the title in color-primary #6A1EBB (a person's name) → a local greeting <h1>, matched to the breadcrumb page-title solo

spec.label: Breadcrumb
spec.value: `breadcrumb` JSON [{label, href?}] → the `›` trail renders as the page title via the reused <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> (heading-level 1)

spec.label: Description
spec.value: optional subtitle, Plus Jakarta 14/22 · text-secondary #4A4A4A, under the title

spec.label: Actions
spec.value: slot="actions" — the consumer drops <aha-button>s here (never a hand-rolled button)

spec.label: Gap
spec.value: 16 between the title area and the actions · 8 title→description and between action buttons

spec.label: Layout
spec.value: desktop / tablet: title left, actions right on one row · phone: actions wrap below the title

props.name: title
props.desc: The page title — rendered via <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> (Heading4 24/600, text-default), unless `highlight` makes it an accent greeting

props.name: highlight
props.desc: Optional substring of `title` rendered in color-primary — e.g. the person's name in a greeting

props.name: breadcrumb
props.desc: When present, a `›` trail renders as the page title via the reused <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> (for a sub-page)

props.name: description
props.desc: Optional subtitle under the title (14px, text-secondary)

props.name: device
props.desc: Deterministic responsive layout — phone wraps the actions below the title

slots.name: actions
slots.desc: The right-hand action buttons — drop <aha-button>s here (reused, never rewritten)

whenToUse.when: the header row of a product page — a title/greeting or a hierarchy trail plus the page's primary actions
only the ancestor trail / page title is needed, with no right-hand actions (use <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> directly — it IS the title this header wraps)
a titled content container, not the page-level header

opinion.note: One primary action on the right at most; the rest secondary. Use a plain `title` for a top-level page (optionally with a `highlight` name), and a `breadcrumb` trail for a sub-page — both render the page heading via the reused <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title">, never a hand-rolled <h1>. Keep the title a short sentence-case phrase.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 Screen heading (fileKey P764iQ6y4ZwW7W3f7FLZyW, node 2237:55733; Desktop / Tablet / Phone device variants). The Desktop symbol = a Breadcrumb instance + a (hidden) description line + a Button Group. Bindings from get_variable_defs: title Heading4 24 / weight 600 / line-height 1.3 / #1A1A1A (text-default), brand-accent name #6A1EBB (color-primary), gaps 8 (GapM) and 16 (GapL), icon 16. REUSE: the title IS the shipped <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> (a Breadcrumb instance in Figma too — the page heading, single-crumb or trailed); the actions are slotted <aha-button>s from the DS button. The only local <h1> is the accent-name greeting the breadcrumb can't render — no second breadcrumb, no hand-rolled title, no hand-rolled button.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probes the greeting header (the accent-name <h1>) and proves the sub-page trail reuses <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title"> and renders a real heading for the current page.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-screen-heading[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;var t=r&&r.querySelector('.title');var hl=r&&r.querySelector('.hl');var d=r&&r.querySelector('.desc');var st=t?getComputedStyle(t):null;var sd=d?getComputedStyle(d):null;var bc=document.querySelector('aha-screen-heading[breadcrumb]');var bcr=bc&&bc.shadowRoot;var ib=bcr&&bcr.querySelector('aha-breadcrumb');var ibr=ib&&ib.shadowRoot;return{titleColor:st?st.color:null,titleSize:st?st.fontSize:null,titleWeight:st?st.fontWeight:null,highlightColor:hl?getComputedStyle(hl).color:null,descColor:sd?sd.color:null,reusesBreadcrumb:!!ib,breadcrumbSize:ib?ib.getAttribute('size'):null,breadcrumbHeading:!!(ibr&&ibr.querySelector('h1'))};})()
